en: Black-and-white street view of a European town showing a corner apartment block with balconies along a cobblestone street. A few vintage cars are parked on the right side of the road, and a church tower with a dome and spire rises in the background. Trees, street lamps, and older houses line the street. The lower left corner contains the caption 'VÄNERSBORG Kyrkogatan' and a serial number '55577' appears in the lower right.
